title: T25 How XORA Analyses a Coin

lines.text: Lesson T25: how XORA analyses a coin. Let's look inside the routine.
lines.say: Lesson T twenty-five: how Zora analyses a coin. Let's look inside the routine.

lines.text: What does XORA do with a coin? Every minute, it runs the same careful routine.
lines.say: What does Zora do with a coin? Every minute, it runs the same careful routine.

lines.text: Candles in. Then volatility, swings, trend, zones, movement and possible setups.
lines.say: Candles in. Then volatility, swings, trend, zones, movement and possible setups.

lines.text: Out comes a plan for one candle, or no plan. Let's follow one fictional coin.
lines.say: Out comes a plan for one candle, or no plan. Let's follow one fictional coin.

lines.text: It starts with history: the coin's recent 1-minute candles. Each shows open, high, low and close.
lines.say: It starts with history: the coin's recent one-minute candles. Each shows open, high, low and close.

lines.text: XORA also checks bigger timeframes, like 5 and 15 minutes, and the order book.
lines.say: Zora also checks bigger timeframes, like five and fifteen minutes, and the order book.

lines.text: These are common techniques. XORA's filters draw on them; the exact rules are its own.
lines.say: These are common techniques. Zora's filters draw on them; the exact rules are its own.

lines.text: One rule matters a lot: XORA uses closed candles only. A forming candle can still change.
lines.say: One rule matters a lot: Zora uses closed candles only. A forming candle can still change.

lines.text: Its high, low and colour can flip before the minute ends, so a signal from it could vanish.
lines.say: Its high, low and colour can flip before the minute ends, so a signal from it could vanish.

lines.text: So at every candle close, the engine makes a fresh plan for each coin.
lines.say: So at every candle close, the engine makes a fresh plan for each coin.

lines.text: Next: volatility, how much price usually moves. A common measure is ATR, average true range.
lines.say: Next: volatility, how much price usually moves. A common measure is ATR, average true range.

lines.text: Simple version: average recent candle sizes. 60, 50, 40, 50 and 100 USDT average 60 USDT.
lines.say: Simple version: average recent candle sizes. Sixty, fifty, forty, fifty and one hundred U-S-D-T average sixty U-S-D-T.

lines.text: Stops need room beyond that normal noise, or they get hit for no real reason.
lines.say: Stops need room beyond that normal noise, or they get hit for no real reason.

lines.text: Swing points are turning points: a high with lower highs on both sides, or a low with higher lows.
lines.say: Swing points are turning points: a high with lower highs on both sides, or a low with higher lows.

lines.text: Highs go 60,100 then 60,250. Lows go 59,900 then 60,040. Higher highs and higher lows: UP.
lines.say: Highs go sixty thousand one hundred then sixty thousand two hundred fifty. Lows go fifty-nine thousand nine hundred then sixty thousand forty. Higher highs and higher lows: UP.

lines.text: Lower highs and lower lows mean DOWN. Anything else is RANGE. Each timeframe gets its own trend.
lines.say: Lower highs and lower lows mean DOWN. Anything else is RANGE. Each timeframe gets its own trend.

lines.text: Swing lows and highs show where buyers or sellers stepped in before.
lines.say: Swing lows and highs show where buyers or sellers stepped in before.

lines.text: XORA draws zones around them: support below price, resistance above. A zone is a band, not a line.
lines.say: Zora draws zones around them: support below price, resistance above. A zone is a band, not a line.

lines.text: Fictional zones here: support 60,000 to 60,060, resistance 60,480 to 60,530.
lines.say: Fictional zones here: support sixty thousand to sixty thousand sixty, resistance sixty thousand four hundred eighty to sixty thousand five hundred thirty.

lines.text: Then movement. Momentum asks how strongly price is moving. RSI is one well-known gauge.
lines.say: Then movement. Momentum asks how strongly price is moving. RSI is one well-known gauge.

lines.text: Pressure compares buyers and sellers trading at market. Volume shows activity versus usual.
lines.say: Pressure compares buyers and sellers trading at market. Volume shows activity versus usual.

lines.text: Strong, agreeing movement adds evidence. Weak or mixed movement is a reason to wait.
lines.say: Strong, agreeing movement adds evidence. Weak or mixed movement is a reason to wait.

lines.text: Now XORA looks for candidate setups, the shapes it trades.
lines.say: Now Zora looks for candidate setups, the shapes it trades.

lines.text: A reaction at support: price dips into the zone and bounces. Or a rejection at resistance.
lines.say: A reaction at support: price dips into the zone and bounces. Or a rejection at resistance.

lines.text: A breakout: a close beyond a level. Or a retest: price comes back to a broken level and holds.
lines.say: A breakout: a close beyond a level. Or a retest: price comes back to a broken level and holds.

lines.text: Our coin dipped into support and closed back up. That candle is the setup candle.
lines.say: Our coin dipped into support and closed back up. That candle is the setup candle.

lines.text: The plan: BUY if price trades above the setup candle's high, 60,120. That price is the trigger.
lines.say: The plan: buy if price trades above the setup candle's high, sixty thousand one hundred twenty. That price is the trigger.

lines.text: The stop sits beyond the support zone, at 59,940. Risk: 180 USDT per BTC, about 0.30%.
lines.say: The stop sits beyond the support zone, at fifty-nine thousand nine hundred forty. Risk: one hundred eighty U-S-D-T per B-T-C, about zero point three percent.

lines.text: The next resistance is 360 USDT above the trigger: 2 R, twice the risk.
lines.say: The next resistance is three hundred sixty U-S-D-T above the trigger: two R, twice the risk.

lines.text: The next candle opens. Price climbs above 60,120, so the plan triggers.
lines.say: The next candle opens. Price climbs above sixty thousand one hundred twenty, so the plan triggers.

lines.text: At the trigger, every check runs again. If something has changed, there is no trade.
lines.say: At the trigger, every check runs again. If something has changed, there is no trade.

lines.text: And if price never reaches 60,120 before the candle closes, the plan expires. A fresh plan follows.
lines.say: And if price never reaches sixty thousand one hundred twenty before the candle closes, the plan expires. A fresh plan follows.

lines.text: A common mistake: reading a plan as a prediction that price will go up.
lines.say: A common mistake: reading a plan as a prediction that price will go up.

lines.text: It is only an if. Most plans expire, no trade is normal, and triggered trades can still lose.
lines.say: It is only an if. Most plans expire, no trade is normal, and triggered trades can still lose.

lines.text: Your turn. The setup candle's high is 60,120. The next candle reaches 60,100, then closes. What happens?
lines.say: Your turn. The setup candle's high is sixty thousand one hundred twenty. The next candle reaches sixty thousand one hundred, then closes. What happens?

lines.text: The trigger was never reached, so no trade. The plan expires, and a fresh plan comes at the close.
lines.say: The trigger was never reached, so no trade. The plan expires, and a fresh plan comes at the close.

lines.text: Remember the limits. These checks read the past. They cannot know what price does next.
lines.say: Remember the limits. These checks read the past. They cannot know what price does next.

lines.text: Fast markets can jump past a stop, and fees apply to every trade.
lines.say: Fast markets can jump past a stop, and fees apply to every trade.

lines.text: XORA does not guarantee profits. Use Demo first. This is not financial advice.
lines.say: Zora does not guarantee profits. Use Demo first. This is not financial advice.

lines.text: Recap. XORA reads closed candles and makes a fresh plan every minute.
lines.say: Recap. Zora reads closed candles and makes a fresh plan every minute.

lines.text: It checks volatility, swings, trend, zones and movement, then looks for a setup.
lines.say: It checks volatility, swings, trend, zones and movement, then looks for a setup.

lines.text: A plan is an if for one candle: a trigger, a stop beyond the level, and checks again.
lines.say: A plan is an if for one candle: a trigger, a stop beyond the level, and checks again.
